image_generation_request.prompt: A high-fidelity 3D animated scene of a T-Rex and an Albertosaurus standing back-to-back to determine who is taller. The Albertosaurus is slightly more slender with slate-blue skin and distinctive deep navy blue 'racing stripes' running from its eyes down its neck, and accurately has three-fingered hands.
